plugin.name: Requirements and one manual step
plugin.description: Needs Fallout 4 VR 1.2.72, F4SE VR and VR Address Library for F4SEVR. Nothing changes in the game until you build your body and outfits in BodySlide with "Build Morphs" ticked (preset "CBBE Zeroed Sliders" or any zeroed preset, then Batch Build): that writes the .tri files this mod deforms. For men, install BodyTalk 4 (Nude + clothing) and build it the same way. BodyTalk's flat-game hands (MaleHands.nif, 1stPersonMaleHands.nif, 1stPersonMaleBody.nif) make VR hands disappear: hide those three files in MO2.

plugin.name: Silhouette bodies, more visible (x2)
plugin.description: The 41 female and 41 male bodies of Silhouette (ReidenXerx, GPL-3.0) with the female values doubled, plus its rules for named people (Piper, Cait, Curie...). Recommended.

plugin.name: Silhouette bodies, original values
plugin.description: Silhouette's own files, unchanged. Realistic and subtle: hard to notice in VR.

plugin.name: Simple example
plugin.description: Two example templates: every human woman gets either a big belly or a curvy body. To check that the mod works.

plugin.name: None (I bring my own BodyGen files)
plugin.description: Installs no BodyGen files. Put your own *_templates.ini / *_morphs.ini in Data\F4SE\Plugins\F4EE\BodyGen\Loose\.
